resolutions.title: A multiline Description disappears from the gate trail
resolutions.evidence: Re-run of the finding's own script before the fix: {"trail":"absent","rejected":1,"render":[["Real finding","specs/a/spec.md",…]]}. After the fix (dist rebuilt): {"trail":[{"title":"Real finding","file":"specs/a/spec.md","severity":"CRITICAL","hasFile":true,"hasDescription":true}],"rejected":0,"render":[["Real finding","specs/a/spec.md"]]}.
resolutions.action: trail.ts parseExternalMarkdown: the `**Description**:` label OPENS the body whether or not text follows on the same line (regex `\s?(.*)$`); `hasDescription` is set by a non-blank body line — same-line or later, fenced lines included, the `**Reproduction**:` label excluded — so the trail reader's has-a-body test is the renderer's blank-body rejection read from the other side; a Description with no non-blank body is rejected by BOTH. The reading is stated ONCE in orbit-conventions' `External-review findings markdown format` (requirement text + the BOTH-readers scenario's WHEN). Three cases added to test/core/trail-rc02b.test.ts: next-line body keyed the same in both readers; blank body rejected by both; fence-only body present in both. Both halves of the blind pair converged on this defect (fresh W2 graded it WARNING on the measured absence of the shape in 62 real files; the external graded CRITICAL by consequence — the gate drops a renderable pass); the fix is the one both recommended.
